usedFor: Each WooCommerce order gives the buyer a HubSpot contact the sales side can use.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in WooCommerce, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It matches on email, so a returning buyer updates their record instead of duplicating.

watchOut: “Create Contact” needs an email, and a repeat buyer through it is a second attempt on one address.
